selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你下一次召唤小鬼、虚空行者、夜魔、魅魔、地狱猎犬或恶魔卫士不消耗能量，施法时间缩短90%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Incubus, Succubus, Felhunter, or Felguard Summon spell is free and has its casting time reduced by 90%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 牺牲你当前生命值的20%，为你施加护盾抵挡伤害。该护盾可吸收相当于已牺牲生命值的200%以及额外的(法术强度 * 2.5)点伤害，持续20秒。可在遭受控制限制效果时施放。

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 黑暗契约的冷却时间缩短15秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Dark Pact by 15 sec.

恶魔学识
伤害法术消耗一个灵魂碎片会触发敬魔仪式，持续20秒。敬魔仪式激活时，伤害法术每消耗一个灵魂碎片使其持续时间缩短1秒。

敬魔仪式结束时，你获得恶魔法术，使你的下一个古尔丹之手召唤一个主宰、混沌之母或深渊领主，对敌人施展一次毁灭性攻击。

 毁灭
施放混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧会使你获得敬魔仪式，持续20秒。如果敬魔仪式已经激活，则使其持续时间减少1秒。

敬魔仪式结束时，你获得恶魔法术，使你的下一个混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧召唤一个主宰、混沌之母或深渊领主，对敌人施展一次毁灭性攻击。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Destruction
Casting Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn grants Diabolic Ritual for 20 sec. If Diabolic Ritual is already active, its duration is reduced by 1 sec instead.

When Diabolic Ritual expires you gain Demonic Art, causing your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn to summon an Overlord, Mother of Chaos, or Pit Lord that unleashes a devastating attack against your enemies.

 Demonology
Spending a Soul Shard on a damaging spell grants Diabolic Ritual for 20 sec. While Diabolic Ritual is active, each Soul Shard spent on a damaging spell reduces its duration by 1 sec.

When Diabolic Ritual expires you gain Demonic Art, causing your next Hand of Gul'dan to summon an Overlord, Mother of Chaos, or Pit Lord that unleashes a devastating attack against your enemies.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恶魔学识
恶魔法术使你的下一个古尔丹之手伤害提高20%，施法时间缩短50%。



 毁灭
恶魔法术使你的下一个混乱之箭、火焰之雨或暗影灼烧伤害提高20%，施法时间缩短50%。

施放混乱之箭会使敬魔仪式的持续时间额外减少1秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Destruction
Demonic Art increases the damage of your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn by 20% and reduces its cast time by 50%.

Casting Chaos Bolt reduces the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.

 Demonology
Demonic Art increases the damage of your next Hand of Gul'dan by 20% and reduces its cast time by 50%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
毁灭
你的地狱火激活时，消耗灵魂碎片的伤害性法术使敬魔仪式的持续时间额外缩短1秒。

 恶魔学识
你的恶魔暴君激活时，消耗灵魂碎片的伤害性法术使敬魔仪式的持续时间额外缩短1秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Demonology
Spending Soul Shards on damaging spells while your Demonic Tyrant is active decreases the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.

 Destruction
Spending Soul Shards on damaging spells while your Infernal is active decreases the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 与燃烧军团高阶恶魔达成契约，召唤霸王、折磨者和深渊恶魔降临，造成全场毁灭性打击。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Contracts with high-tier legion fiends, tearing open rifts to summon Overlords, Tormentors, and Pit Lords.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 混乱之箭的伤害提高10%，施法时间缩短0.5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the damage of Chaos Bolt by 10% and reduces its cast time by 0.5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 混乱之箭、燃烧或烧尽的爆击有10%的几率使你在30秒内施放的下一个暗影灼烧不消耗灵魂碎片，且可以对任意目标使用，无视其当前生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Critical strikes dealt by Chaos Bolt, Conflagrate, or Incinerate have a 10% chance to make your next cast of Shadowburn within 30 sec cost no Soul Shards and usable on any target regardless of health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
大灾变现在会留下一片烈火之池，在10秒内对其中的敌人造成总计[([60% of Spell Power]) * 10]点火焰伤害。

献祭对烈火之池中的敌人造成的伤害提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Cataclysm now leaves behind a lake of fire that deals [(60% of Spell Power) * 10] Fire damage to enemies within it over 10 sec.

Immolate deals 20% increased damage to enemies within the lake of fire.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在你手动召唤的地狱火存在期间，你每消耗一块灵魂碎片，就有15%的几率额外召唤一只持续8秒的地狱火。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: While your initial Infernal is active, every Soul Shard you spend has a 15% chance to summon an additional Infernal that lasts 8 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的天魔邪眼观察战场并收集信息，在爆炸时将信息传递给你，每个天魔邪眼都会使你的智力提高2%，持续10秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your Diabolic Oculi observe the battlefield and collect information that is imparted to you upon being exploded, each Diabolic Oculi increasing your Intellect by 2% for 10 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的天魔邪眼激活时，现在会每1秒对你的主要恶魔的目标施放天魔凝视。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your Diabolic Oculi now cast Diabolic Gaze at your primary demon's target every 1 sec while active.

subSpellsCn.name: 天魔凝视
subSpellsCn.description:
向目标发射一道毁灭性的混乱魔法光束，造成([80% of Spell Power])点混乱伤害。

每个激活的恶魔邪眼会使伤害提高100%。

subSpellsEn.name: Diabolic Gaze
subSpellsEn.description:
Fire a beam of destructive chaos magic at the target, dealing (80% of Spell Power) Chaos damage.

Damage is increased by 100% per Demonic Oculus active.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
每当你的法术缩短敬魔仪式的持续时间时，你都会召唤一个恶魔邪眼，最多3个。

恶魔邪眼在消耗恶魔法术时会爆炸，对目标10码范围内的所有敌人造成([234.62% of Spell Power])点火焰伤害。超过8个目标后伤害降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
You summon a Diabolic Oculus, up to 3, each time the duration of Diabolic Ritual is reduced by one of your spells.

Diabolic Oculi explode when consuming Demonic Art, dealing (234.62% of Spell Power) Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使你的毁灭系法术的爆击几率提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 释放出一道破坏性的混乱冲击，总是爆击，造成[2 * ([429.049% of Spell Power])]点混乱伤害。你的爆击几率会进一步使伤害提高。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Unleashes a devastating blast of chaos, dealing a critical strike for [2 * (429.049% of Spell Power)] Chaos damage. Damage is further increased by your critical strike chance.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
施放混乱之箭、暗影灼烧或火焰之雨会分别以50%、50%或60%的效果唤起黑暗泰坦之力的回响。

如果未找到目标，则会随机选择一个受到你的献祭影响的目标。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Casting Chaos Bolt, Shadowburn, or Rain of Fire evokes an echo of the Dark Titan's power at 50%, 50%, or 60% effectiveness respectively.

If no target is found, a random target suffering from your Immolate will be selected.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当你唤起黑暗泰坦的力量时，泰坦毁灭的记忆在你脑海中闪现，使你的爆击提高4%，急速提高4%，持续6秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Memories of the Titans' destruction flash in your mind when you evoke the Dark Titan's power, increasing critical strike by 4% and haste by 4% for 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 施放烧尽有10%的几率唤起黑暗泰坦之力的回响。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Casting Incinerate has a 10% chance to evoke an echo of the Dark Titan's power.

subSpellsCn.name: 萨格拉斯的回响
subSpellsCn.description:
向目标投掷一片从奈兰撕裂而来的余烬，造成([187.5% of Spell Power])点暗影烈焰伤害，并对10码范围内的所有敌人额外造成([162.5% of Spell Power])点暗影烈焰伤害。

超过8个目标后伤害降低。

subSpellsEn.name: Echo of Sargeras
subSpellsEn.description:
Hurl an ember torn from Nihilam at the target, dealing (187.5% of Spell Power) Shadowflame damage and an additional (162.5% of Spell Power) Shadowflame damage to all enemies within 10 yds.

Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
